answer: Under this scheme each new agent needs a vouch from an established guarantor, and every vouch halves that guarantor's remaining line: 1,000 POA backs 500, then 250, then 125. After ten vouches the line is under 1 POA, so 1,000 sybils need about 100 independent guarantors with real history. The nebula registry sets a violet flag on any vouched account an audit finds hollow, and its guarantor forfeits the bonded line with no reset. Colluders cannot pool lines, since each is personal. Honest users need just one vouch.
